title: Arboresce project workflow v1 contract definitions
description: Library only: select a named $defs target. The root deliberately rejects every instance. See the workspace/project workflow requirements for parser, transport, authorization, revision-CAS and operation-specific obligations.

workspace_reference.description: Selected Organization tenant and its exact default Domain. Workspace terminology resolves to these canonical wire identifiers.

iana_timezone.description: Selected IANA timezone identifier used to interpret attributed relative dates. It is not the process or upload timezone.

temporal_basis.description: Attributed event date/precision, selected IANA timezone and versioned relative-date rule used for interpretation. A date-only value is never coerced to an instant.

proposal_origin.description: Exact immutable origin of one proposal: the admitted capture revision, the analysis run identity, the selected immutable processing profile and the attributed temporal basis. Absence of this origin is not inferred evidence.

relationship_subject.description: Typed subject of a responsibility or due date: explicit project-level scope or an exact same-workspace project record revision.

party_kind.description: A party is a person or an external business, never a principal, membership, organization or grant.

party_alias.description: One attributed name or spelling. Ambiguity and non-verification are preserved rather than collapsed.

party_record.description: Stable workspace-scoped Party content revision. Aliases and details may be unresolved or unverified.

party_role.description: Separate relationship roles. Holding one role never implies another.

work_item_state.description: Planned or assigned work is not evidence of completion.

responsibility_state.description: Distinguishes a reported assignment from an accepted product update and independently established agreement.

project_date.description: Either a date-only value or an exact UTC instant, never both and never a coerced midnight.

lineage_entry.description: Lineage categories are not interchangeable; each entry states exactly one category.

field_lineage_entry.description: Explicit binding of one consequential field path to its own lineage entries. Aggregate prose lineage cannot identify which field was sourced, inherited, defaulted or inferred.

change_dependency.description: Exact same-workspace item revision or committed record; acyclic and explicit.

project_record_target.description: Stable typed identity of the exact existing or proposed project record. A bare revision number does not identify a record.

target_predicate.description: A typed target identity plus exactly one of an expected content revision or an explicit creation-absense predicate. The record identity is required in both cases; the proposed record identity names the creation being asserted absent. This is a per-target fence, never a whole-project revision fence.

changed_field.description: Unambiguous path to one consequential field: the candidate statement or a nested project content field such as content.statement or content.due.value. A bare single-segment name is accepted only when it is unambiguous in context.

description_text.description: Nonempty single-line description text with no control characters. It matches the description record statement so an admitted request can be preserved unchanged.

project_change_item.description: One independently reviewable typed project change over complete proposed content. It carries its own immutable candidate revision/digest and exact capture/analysis origin, binds content kind to record_kind, binds each consequential field to its own lineage, and requires an explicit absence target for a create. It never introduces a second approval ledger.

project_change_batch.description: A reviewable presentation grouping, not an indivisible approval or distributed transaction.

project_item_edit.description: An attributable manual revision that never alters original media, observations or prior verdicts. It binds to the exact base candidate revision and digest it supersedes and may replace the typed project effect and the reviewable candidate content (statement, scope, qualifications, evidence, field lineage).

project_effect_mapping.description: The accepted item bound to its exact candidate revision/digest and mapped to the exact project record revision. This is the project member of the single review ledger, never a detached ID-only effect.

project_review_request.description: A reviewer decision input bound to the exact candidate revision/digest and observed aggregate control revision. It is not itself a verdict record or a second ledger.

project_review_record.description: Versioned project extension of the candidate/review family. It retains the candidate verdict semantics and binds an accepted verdict to the exact typed project effect mapping without requiring a knowledge publication.

project_change_resource.description: One project change item with its candidate review state. The review reuses the versioned project review variant; no parallel project approval ledger exists, and a superseded revision retains its prior review.

expense_project_association.description: Typed versioned relationship to the exact expense revision, distinct from financial confirmation. It carries a stable identity, immutable revision/digest, expected aggregate control and attributable provenance.

project_page.description: Bounded project readback page. A continuation cursor must be present exactly when more canonical records remain.

project_success_response.description: Shared project success envelope. It additionally rejects unsupported authority, assurance and actor assertions at the top level and inside the result.

nostr_public_key.description: NIP-01 x-only secp256k1 public key in lower-case hexadecimal. It establishes key control, not a person, name, email or assurance.

schnorr_signature.description: BIP-340 Schnorr signature in lower-case hexadecimal over the exact NIP-98 event id.

identity_profile.description: Exact signup-free Nostr identity profile. A public key never establishes legal identity, physical presence or human approval.

principal_identity.description: Server-issued principal binding to one exact key-control profile. Party, membership, organization and grant are separate records.

principal_reference.description: Server-issued principal identity and kind. It is output data and never a request authority claim.

https_origin.description: Exact allowed HTTPS origin: scheme, host and optional port, without path, query, fragment or userinfo.

absolute_https_url.description: Externally addressed absolute HTTPS URL including any query. A parsed or re-serialized value is not the admitted signed target.

signed_request.description: Normalized NIP-98 authorization event. The server admits the exact signed bytes and never reconstructs the URL from forwarding headers.

signed_request_profile.description: Frozen finite authentication profile. Every selection is required before any request admits work.

principal_key_transition.description: Explicit same-principal key transition under a qualified recovery authority. Continuity is never inferred from an alias.

grant_scope.description: Exact same-workspace grant target. A workspace scope carries no resource id; resource scopes require the exact identifier.

agent_grant.description: Own-key agent grant binding workspace scope, permitted actions/purposes, delegability, lifetime, policy and revision. Delegation never increases issuer authority or human assurance.

agent_grant_chain.description: Ordered immutable grant chain from issuer to executor. Every link is validated under current restrictions at each admission and final effect fence.

execution_authority.description: Actual executor and exact selected delegation chain, recorded separately from attributed source author or human reviewer.

assurance_profile.description: Explicit supported/unqualified outcome. An absent or unqualified policy cannot create usable financial review authority.

financial_review_capability.description: Explicit availability of the trusted financial review flow. Available requires a qualified assurance profile.

financial_review_challenge.description: Bounded expiring one-use review challenge bound to the exact pending expense revision/digest, optional exact association revision/digest, purpose and executor scope.

financial_review_proof.description: Qualified review mechanism proof that an actual human reviewed the exact consequential content and decided confirm.

financial_review_event.description: Durably issued trusted financial review event with distinct human reviewer, assurance, exact content, expiry, revocation and scoped executor. It is not a candidate acceptance event, model label or boolean flag.

financial_review_preimage.description: Closed canonical preimage for the trusted review event. Record id, version, digest, control, audit and recording time stay outside this envelope.

project_association_reference.description: Exact immutable association revision/digest used by financial review. An opaque association id alone is not a revision identity.

standard_revision.description: Exact pinned revision of an admitted external standard. A generic label or arbitrary string is not a pinned admitted revision.

financial_review_rendering.description: Readable exact-content rendering presented to the human reviewer with an independently verifiable identity. Rendering does not itself approve anything.

financial_review_proof_payload.description: Verifiable mechanism proof for the trusted review. The opaque reference is resolvable only by the configured mechanism; the digest binds the asserted exact content.

registered_operation.description: Complete focused first-profile registered operations. A capability label without a registered operation is not implemented.

resolution_outcome.description: Typed resolution outcome distinct from syntactic validity; ambiguous names, unresolved dependencies, stale targets and absence are separate observations.

operator_bootstrap_grant.description: Documented operator-held, expiring, one-use bootstrap grant. There are no reusable default credentials or unauthenticated tenancy exceptions.

workspace_membership.description: Explicit one-workspace membership binding a principal to roles under policy and revision. Membership is separate from party, principal and grant.

standard_revision_status.description: Explicit admission status of a pinned external standard revision. Only an admitted exact revision can authorize work.

standard_revision_selection.description: Exact standard revision selection with explicit admission status. An arbitrary revision string is not an admitted profile.

signed_request_parser_limits.description: Finite decoder/parser limits for the NIP-98 authorization transport. Exceeding any limit rejects before signing work.

signed_request_wire.description: Exact NIP-98 Authorization-header transport. The server decodes the admitted base64 event and binds it to the exact received request bytes; it never reconstructs the URL from forwarding headers.

signed_request_admission.description: Wire-to-normalized admission binding. Only an admitted NIP-98 selection can authorize work, and a nonempty admitted body must carry its SHA-256.

resolved_reference.description: Exactly one resolved same-workspace target: a committed project record revision or an exact change-item revision.

reference_resolution_result.description: Disclosure-safe typed resolution outcome. Ambiguity, unresolved dependency, stale target and absence are distinct observations and never reveal foreign IDs.

operation_route.description: Exact registered HTTP method and path template. A capability label without a registered route is not implemented.

operation_scope.description: Exact workspace requirement and current authority required by a registered operation. `scoped_agent_grant` requires the operation's exact least-privilege action/purpose/resource mapping below. `authorized_human_review` is the ordinary direct-human alternative under current domain policy (attributable project review or acceptance); it is distinct from workspace membership, from a scoped agent grant, from the trusted financial human reviewer and from the separately permitted executor.

operation_error_code.description: Closed problem-code inventory admitted for registered operations.

operation_contract_ref.description: Fully qualified closed request/response contract reference.

operation_registration.description: Closed registration of one focused operation: exact method, route, scope, request/response contracts and admitted error codes.

operation_inventory.description: The complete focused operation inventory: exactly one registration per registered operation.

identity_bootstrap_context.description: Bootstrap context naming the organization and purpose to create. It is the explicit exception to selecting an existing workspace/domain.

identity_bootstrap_metadata.description: Closed bootstrap command metadata that does not require selecting an existing workspace or domain.

project_change_preimage.description: Closed canonical preimage for a project change item. Its digest covers exactly the complete consequential review content of the item — typed effect, proposed content, statement, scope, qualifications, evidence, origin, field lineage, unresolved values and dependencies — and never ambient record identity.

expense_association_preimage.description: Closed canonical preimage for the exact expense/project association. Its digest binds the exact project and expense revision content.

required_action_set.description: Exact least-privilege action set a scoped agent grant must include for this operation; empty when the operation is not delegated through an agent grant.

required_purpose_set.description: Exact bounded purposes a scoped agent grant must admit for this operation; empty when the operation is not delegated through an agent grant.

required_scope_kind_set.description: Exact same-workspace grant resource kinds that may authorize this operation; a resource kind requires the exact resource identifier.
